question_text: A 19-year-old woman comes to the physician because of increased sweating for the past 6 months. She has not had any fevers, chills, weight loss, or night sweats. Her temperature is 36.6°C (98°F). Physical examination shows moist skin in the axillae and on the palms, soles, and face. Which of the following drugs is most likely to be effective for this patient's condition?
